mapper.select: select from nad_user_applicant_access where user_id = #{userId} and applicant_id = #{applicantId} and application_id is null and status = 'ACTIVE' and limit 1

select from nad_user_applicant_access where applicant_id = #{applicantId} order by field(status, 'ACTIVE', 'PENDING', 'EXPIRED', 'REVOKED'), field(access_role, 'OWNER', 'AGENT', 'GUARDIAN', 'VIEWER'), id

mapper.insert: insert into nad_user_applicant_access (user_id, applicant_id, application_id, access_role, status, invited_email, capability_overrides_json, is_interim, granted_by_user_id, granted_at, expires_at, create_by, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{applicantId}, #{applicationId}, #{accessRole}, #{status}, #{invitedEmail}, #{capabilityOverridesJson}, #{interim}, #{grantedByUserId}, #{grantedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{createBy}, now())
